verdict: The non-ask-cue bucket is captured at a much lower rate than the ask-cue bucket, so the register's coverage does not rise much: the union figure in frame A is ~9.6%. The bucket is also mostly not operator speech - 47 of the 60 sampled clauses come from agent-harness exports and two independent speaker passes put the non-operator share at 62-75% - so its low rate says more about what the unit population contains than about what the register missed.
limitations: capture@5 is recall of the k=5 retrieval system, not ultimate recall
n=60 per bucket; the by_speaker split is a post-hoc subset with tiny n and is explanatory only
the union range adds independent bounds and is not a joint interval
